data.content: Gerti Foods, a newly established company in baking industry for production of frozen products with an outstanding dedication to quality, managed to replicate well preserved family recipes that were saved for more than 200 years.
Faced with the challenge of modernizing its brand while preserving its heritage, the company needed to enhance its market presence and appeal to a broader audience.
We created eye-catching merchandise for Gerti Foods, including apparel, vehicle branding, caps, menus, and packaging that celebrate their heritage and commitment to quality.
Each item features warm colors and contemporary design, enhancing brand visibility and strengthening customer connections while showcasing Gerti Foods’ passion for exceptional culinary experiences
We designed a user-friendly website for Gerti Foods that effectively highlights their traditional recipes and premium products.
The site employs warm, inviting colors to reflect their heritage while incorporating modern design elements for a contemporary feel.
With intuitive navigation, customers can effortlessly browse the offerings and gain insight into the company’s dedication to quality, enhancing their overall experience and connection with the brand.
For Gerti Foods, we developed an engaging social media strategy featuring vibrant imagery and compelling content that highlighted their culinary heritage.

By showcasing traditional recipes and innovative products, we connected with consumers across platforms. This approach fostered a vibrant online community, driving engagement and excitement around Gerti Foods' offerings.
The stylish website and cohesive, branding and social media designs sparked more customer inquiries, enhancing their market presence.
